config.notes: University of Waikato qualification pages (www.waikato.ac.nz/study/qualifications/... and /int/study/qualifications/...). Plain HTML, no page data. Each page has a summary line near the top: '<points>, <duration> <campus> <school> <start trimesters with months> Domestic: $X per year, International: $Y per year'; some pages print the labels (Points and Duration, Locations, Start Dates, Estimated fees). Intakes = start trimesters with months in brackets (e.g. 'Trimester A (March) and Trimester B (July)'). Fee = the 'International: $Y per year' figure only; pages that give 'International: $Y' without 'per year' (whole-programme figures, e.g. MDigiBus 120/180 pts) are not read. IELTS is not on course pages: central rule at https://www.waikato.ac.nz/int/about/calendar/admission/english-language-requirements/ (UG 6.0 no band below 5.5; PG 6.5 no band below 6.0; LLB 6.5/6.0; BNurs 6.5/6.5; ITE 7.0/7.0; MPSOCS, MClinPrac(Midwifery), MNursPrac, MPharmPrac 7.0/7.0). Teaching periods: https://www.waikato.ac.nz/about/calendar/important-dates/teaching-and-assessment-periods/ (Trimester A starts March, B July, C/G November, H January); term_months not set because some pages print February for Trimester A.
